description: Publication-only provenance amendments. No new measurement, training or evaluation was performed. Exact raw records remain immutable at their source commit and in private hash-addressed storage. These derivatives must not replace original operator authorization, checkpoint or dataset inputs. All numeric lexemes, result fields, hashes and simulation labels are preserved. Only identifying string metadata is withheld or normalized.
jsonl_pointer_convention: JSONL metadata pointers use the zero-based /record-N/ prefix; the remaining components are JSON pointers within that record.
operator_artifact_boundary: Original operator artifacts and fingerprints remain immutable outside Git. The append-only timeline writer keeps its original output contract and must not write to publication derivatives.
